reviews.comment: Take Professor York if you want to actually learn. If you are willing to read often, contribute in class, and work diligently, you will be just fine. She is passionate, understanding, and easily accessible. Great course.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: She is nice and very intelligent, but she takes forever to grade and grades harshly. No one, and I mean no one, was able to make higher than a 95 on papers. Try taking someone else if you can.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had no other option but to take York and I thought id be okay, but this class has totally drained me. I am on the border of an A rn and Im stressed bc she hasnt graded major assignments and I need to know where I sit before the final. Attendance is stressful, I do not think its fair to hold students to such strict guidelines- life is unexpected!!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Ms. York is a bit strict on grading and deadlines and offers very little feedback (and when she does it's not in a timely manner). However, if you are already a strong writer and are able to sit through classes and turn in assignments on time, the class is an easy A. You will not learn much, so only take York if you are a decent writer.

I thought this class was going to be an easy A. Come to find out, she barely gives any feedback, waits to the last minute to grade, and then gives a horrible grade when she finally does grade. It took her 2 months to grade an 300 word essay. Really try and not take this prof unless you want to be suprised by your final grade.

overall she's a good prof but if you hate reading and writing don't take she assigns 2-3 papers a week along with discussion post almost every class. If you don't like medieval times either don't take. Super slow grader
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: York is a grad student, so she can be a slow grader, but it is evident she cares about what she teaches. I took her for Engl 203, and her class is easy as long as you put in the work. Be sure to follow her criteria for sure, or you will fault with your grades. She is super chill and easygoing! Easy recommend.

Great professor! Cares about her students and is very clear about assignments and expectations. If you do your work and engage in class, you are going to do well. It's a writing class so expect papers, but she does an amazing job breaking down the paper and making the work less daunting. I definitely recommend taking Professor York!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very good professor, they helped me improve my writing. For this class you get what you put in, and she truly cares about her students and provides extremely valuable feedback which I plan to use far into the future.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT
